title: This looks like an interesting approach I could take to try and finalize the #indieweb migration of my courses. But I want to try and do it on my own.
summary: This looks like an interesting approach I could take to try and finalize the #indieweb migration of my courses. But I want to try and do it on my own. I should be able to mark up the html of a learning html and then use the classes to render it differently on my syllabus website and class website.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
This looks like an interesting approach I could take to try and finalize the #indieweb migration of my courses.

But I want to try and do it on my own. I should be able to mark up the html of a learning html and then use the classes to render it differently on my syllabus website and class website.
